description: Erection of a single storey side and rear extension, part first floor rear extension and side and rear roof extension to the house.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.

Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.

Condition : 3 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: [PL4-00, PL4-01, PL4-02, PL4-03, PL4-04, PL4-05, PL4-05, Design and Access Statement, Planning Fire Safety Statement & Reasonable Exception Statement (RES). Received on 13/04/2023].
Condition : 4 - No additional windows or openings shall be formed in the side elevation of the development hereby permitted.
Condition : 5 - The extensions and accommodation hereby approved shall not be used other than for purposes ancillary to the dwelling known as 32 Grovestile Waye.
